mapper.sql: id, content, description, icon, points, status, complete_type, period_type, claim_required, sort_order, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM couple_task ORDER BY status DESC, sort_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT FROM couple_task WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT FROM couple_task WHERE status = 1 AND complete_type = #{completeType} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT FROM couple_task WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO couple_task (content, description, icon, points, status, complete_type, period_type, claim_required, sort_order, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{content}, #{description}, #{icon}, #{points}, #{status}, #{completeType}, #{periodType}, #{claimRequired}, #{sortOrder}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE couple_task SET content = #{content}, description = #{description}, icon = #{icon}, points = #{points}, status = #{status}, complete_type = #{completeType}, period_type = #{periodType}, claim_required = #{claimRequired}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
